title: People who help us
examples: Who helps us when we are sick?
Can you name some helpers in our town?

explain.say: Today we learn about people who help us.
Doctors help us when we are sick.
Nurses take care of us when we are hurt.
Firefighters help us when there is a fire.
Police officers keep us safe on the street.
Vets help the animals when they are sick.

faq.q: Who helps us when we are sick?
faq.a: Doctors and nurses help us when we are sick. They give us medicine and check us over.
asks: Who do I go to when I feel unwell?

faq.a: Firefighters use big hoses to put out fires and keep us safe from smoke.
asks: What do they bring to a fire?

faq.q: Do police officers only catch bad people?
faq.a: No, police officers help keep everyone safe and tell us what to do in danger.
asks: Is the police only for bad guys?

faq.a: No, vets only help animals like dogs and cats stay healthy.
Some helpers wear uniforms, but some, like a doctor, might wear different clothes.
asks: Do all helpers wear special clothes?

facts: Doctors help people when they are sick.
Firefighters use hoses to put out fires.
Police officers help keep the community safe.

quiz.say: Who helps when there is a fire?
quiz.why: Firefighters have big trucks and hoses to put out fires.

wrong.1: Police help with safety, but firefighters handle the fire itself.
wrong.2: Doctors help people who are sick, not burning buildings.
wrong.3: Nurses look after people who are hurt, not putting out big fires.

quiz.say: If a dog is sick, who should you call?
quiz.why: Vets are special helpers for animals like dogs and cats.

wrong.1: Police keep people safe, they do not treat sick animals.
wrong.2: Firefighters put out fires, they do not give animal medicine.

quiz.say: Who keeps us safe on the street?
quiz.why: Police officers wear uniforms and help keep our streets safe.

wrong.0: Vets only help animals, not people on the street.
wrong.2: Nurses work in hospitals to care for people.
wrong.3: Doctors give us check-ups, but police watch for danger.
